question: What is Unstable Universe?
answer: It is a scripted Minecraft video series. The wiki says it follows four protagonists: ParrotX2, Wemmbu, SpokeIsHere, and FlameFrags. It started on April 21, 2024. It has 152 episodes and it is in its third season. It is also called Unstable SMP.

question: Who made Unstable Universe?
answer: The wiki says it was created by ParrotX2. He is one of the four protagonists. He also made Lifesteal SMP. He is the one who started the whole thing.

question: Who are the four protagonists?
answer: ParrotX2, Wemmbu, SpokeIsHere, and FlameFrags. The wiki says each one tells their own side of the same wars. Parrot is the smart one. Wemmbu is the loud one. Spoke is the manipulative one. Flame is the stubborn fighter.

answer: Parrot is one of the four protagonists. The wiki says he is a highly calculated strategist. He is charitable and selfless and gives riches to new players. He is also idealistic and heroic. He believes he has to save everyone. Even if it costs him.
